title: Jane Doe CV
cv:
# Jane Doe

Senior backend engineer based in Córdoba, Argentina.

# Experience

## Acme Payments (2020-2025)

Designed and built payment REST APIs in C# with ASP.NET Core on .NET 8. Tuned PostgreSQL queries and indexes, cutting p95 latency from 800 ms to 120 ms. Led a team of four engineers and mentored two juniors through code reviews and pairing.

## Globex (2017-2020)

Built customer-facing single-page applications with React and TypeScript. Wrote unit tests with Jest and end-to-end tests with Playwright.

## Initech (2015-2017)

Containerized legacy services with Docker and moved them to Kubernetes on AWS. Wrote Terraform modules for the networking and databases, and set up CI/CD pipelines with GitHub Actions.

# Side projects

Built a retrieval-augmented chatbot over company documentation using OpenAI embeddings and a vector database.

# Education

BSc in Computer Science, National University of Córdoba, 2015.

# Languages

Spanish (native), English (fluent, C1).
